# Safe variance calculation

<small>Source: [`R/utils.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/utils.R) · Help: `?safe_var`</small>

Computes the variance of `x` while guarding against
near-zero values that could lead to division by zero
in subsequent calculations.

## Usage

```r
safe_var(x)
```

## Arguments

`x`
:   Numeric vector.

## Value

A variance value with a minimum of `.Machine$double.eps`.
